name: PromptLayer
desc: Prompt versioning, regression tests and production logging.
desc_zh: 提示词版本管理、回归测试与线上日志。
solves: Keeps prompts under version control with tests attached, so editing one does not silently break a feature.
solves_zh: 提示词纳入版本管理并附带测试，改一句不会悄悄弄坏功能。
best_for: Reaching for it when prompt edits are getting risky and you need rollback.
best_for_zh: 改提示词风险变大、需要能回滚时。
notes: 外部发现渠道补录：2026 LLM observability and prompt-management tool comparisons。来源：https://checkthat.ai/blog/llm-observability-tools
